sections.lead: Warm and sunny, the last dry weekend for a while.
items: Today (Sat): partly sunny, 71/45, 0% rain, light wind 2-5 mph. Sunrise 6:39, sunset 5:01.
Hour by hour: 5am 52, 8am 54, 10am 60, noon 68, 2pm 71 (peak), 4pm 70, 5pm 67, 8pm 59, 10pm 57, evening turns partly cloudy.
The rest of the grid: Sun cloudy 70/51 with the new moon that night. Mon sunny 70/51. Tue sunny 68/47. Wed sunny 66/47. Thu partly sunny 65/50. Fri sunny 66/53 but gusty (SW gusts to 28 mph).
First rain in weeks shows up late next weekend: 75% Saturday night Nov 14, showers Sunday Nov 15.

Plain English: the transiting Moon sits exactly on your natal Moon this morning, which astrologers call a lunar return, your once-a-month personal new beginning. With loving Venus sitting on the same spot, today favors quiet self-care, a tidy restart, and gentle plans over big pushes.
How to use it: it's a perfect day to make one clean decision about the job search, like clearing your review queue, then rest. Momentum restarts Monday.

Specifics: Moon Libra 26.7 conj natal Moon 0.2 (lunar return); Venus (R) Libra 26.4 conj natal Moon 0.6; Mercury (R) Scorpio 8.0 square natal Sun 1.1; Sun opp natal Asc 1.2; Pluto sextile natal Moon 0.9; Saturn (R) Aries 11.9 trine natal Sun 2.7.

Zero new postings passed the filters overnight; the five added at yesterday's 3pm sweep are still waiting on your review on the Job Hunt tab: Harvey EA, Flexport Business Operations Manager (Office of the CEO), Figma EA x2, Stripe Administrative Business Partner.
Boards note: Uber Freight and Serve's feeds wouldn't load again; Lightspeed and NFX stay queued for the 3pm sweep.

sections.lead: A good sports night and slow ballot math.
items: Antioch High football rolled to its 11th straight win on Friday night.
The county posted a fresh ballot-count update Friday afternoon; Joy Motts still holds the early lead in Antioch District 1.
Oakland police are investigating what appear to be deliberate dog attacks on dogs and people.
No new mail since yesterday's brief: the Mintive and Kenco declines stand, and no interview requests have arrived.
Flexport and Rothy's remain quiet confirmations.

sections.lead: Empty calendar: a true day off.
items: Easy win: say the word and I'll draft the Granite thank-yous, with your paving-vs-dirt mix question folded in for Brian.
Top 3: (1) Granite thank-yous, (2) review the five leads on the Job Hunt tab, (3) confirm the Parchment diploma mailing address (overdue).
Also waiting: the Marvell EA application (Workday sign-in re-save link), the 5 LinkedIn note drafts, and the SDI DE 2501 paper form.
The 3pm sweep fires as usual; the expense-report reminder stays quiet until Tue Nov 17.
Nothing on Tony's calendar through Sunday.

sections.lead: New moon tomorrow night, rain the weekend after.
items: Sunday is cloudy but mild at 70/51 with the new moon; the first real rain of the season arrives the following weekend.
